name: IC — PWL
description: IC cluster containing 6 through-hole parts using PWL footprints (PWL_5 to PWL_10) from the chilaboard Altium library.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a through-hole IC with a PWL footprint variant (PWL_5 to PWL_10).
Verify compatibility with parts sourced from the chilaboard Altium library.
Note that all 6 parts in this cluster are categorized in quality tier C.
avoid_when: Surface-mount assembly is required instead of through-hole mounting.
The PCB design requires a footprint other than PWL_5, PWL_6, PWL_7, PWL_8, PWL_9, or PWL_10.
Higher quality tier parts (Tier A or B) are required for the design.
